subject: intr
title: INTR.------MOT.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 304 (PR.S(RD)II-58). INTR (interpretation) is the subject; MOT-DY is the partner. From the subject: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics), INFO-ALGN (information alignment) and POL-DY (political dynamics). From SOC-RT-DY: RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits). From INFO-ALGN: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) and PRI-INFO (principle information). From PRI-INFO: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From SPT-DY: AFI (affinity insight). From POL-DY: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From T-C-IMP: LG-EXT (logical extension).
